title: $4.2M Enterprise Hybrid Quantum Compute Reservation Agreement – 127-Qubit QPU Access
executive_summary: PharmaCorp seeks a 3-year reserved access deal for hybrid quantum-classical workloads on 127-qubit superconducting QPUs with integrated cryogenic monitoring. The vendor proposal promises guaranteed queue priority and premium telemetry, which must be validated against engineering constraints before signing.

proposal_document.title: Commercial Proposal v1.0
proposal_document.text:
We propose dedicated QPU queue reservation with guaranteed job start in under 5 minutes for all priority workloads, backed by 99.99% QPU availability SLA. Our platform delivers real-time cryogenic telemetry streaming at 1kHz resolution with full dilution refrigerator diagnostics, plus unlimited error mitigation included for all quantum circuits at no extra cost.

The Hybrid Quantum-Classical API gateway ensures 99.9% monthly uptime for classical orchestration, with seamless auto-scaling to 10,000 concurrent hybrid jobs. All services are production-ready with zero scheduled downtime and enterprise-grade support for 127-qubit superconducting processors.

technical_specification.title: Technical Architecture Spec v4.2
technical_specification.text:
QPU access operates on a shared fair-share queue with best-effort scheduling; during peak demand queue wait times may extend up to 4 hours with no guaranteed start time. QPU system availability target is 95% excluding scheduled cryogenic maintenance windows every Tuesday 02:00-06:00 UTC and unscheduled recalibration periods.

The classical API gateway provides 99.9% monthly uptime excluding maintenance, supporting up to 10,000 concurrent hybrid job submissions with rate limiting at 500 req/s per tenant. Cryogenic telemetry is sampled at 0.1Hz and exposed via batched polling every 60 seconds; advanced zero-noise extrapolation and probabilistic error cancellation are available as metered add-ons requiring separate enablement.

commitments.claim: Guaranteed QPU queue reservation with job start under 5 minutes and 99.99% QPU availability
commitments.proposal_quote: guaranteed job start in under 5 minutes for all priority workloads
commitments.spec_quote: during peak demand queue wait times may extend up to 4 hours with no guaranteed start time
commitments.explanation: Proposal guarantees a 5-minute start time while spec explicitly disclaims any guaranteed start time and allows up to 4-hour waits on best-effort fair-share scheduling, directly contradicting both latency and 99.99% availability claims versus 95% target.

commitments.claim: Real-time cryogenic telemetry streaming at 1kHz resolution
commitments.proposal_quote: real-time cryogenic telemetry streaming at 1kHz resolution with full dilution refrigerator diagnostics
commitments.explanation: Spec defines only 0.1Hz sampling with 60-second batched polling and makes no mention of 1kHz streaming or real-time dilution refrigerator diagnostics, leaving the sales claim entirely unsupported.

commitments.claim: Unlimited error mitigation included for all quantum circuits at no extra cost
commitments.proposal_quote: unlimited error mitigation included for all quantum circuits at no extra cost
commitments.spec_quote: advanced zero-noise extrapolation and probabilistic error cancellation are available as metered add-ons requiring separate enablement
commitments.explanation: Spec states advanced mitigation techniques are metered add-ons, but does not clarify what basic versus unlimited mitigation includes, leaving uncertainty whether proposal promise covers only baseline readout correction or the paid advanced methods.

commitments.claim: Hybrid API gateway with 99.9% uptime and 10,000 concurrent hybrid jobs
commitments.proposal_quote: ensures 99.9% monthly uptime for classical orchestration, with seamless auto-scaling to 10,000 concurrent hybrid jobs
commitments.spec_quote: provides 99.9% monthly uptime excluding maintenance, supporting up to 10,000 concurrent hybrid job submissions
commitments.explanation: Spec confirms the same 99.9% monthly uptime target for the classical gateway and the same 10,000 concurrent job capacity, directly supporting the commercial claim subject to stated maintenance exclusions.
